title: Timeline for Universities and Schools to Return to Normalised Face-to-face Classes
what_it_is: Timeline for Universities and Schools to Return to Normalised Face-to-face Classes

sections.label: Resumption of school activities
sections.summary: Lower-risk CCAs and activities have resumed, and IHLs have gradually increased students on campus for practicums, labs, classes and selected non-timetabled activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Lower-risk co-curricular activities or CCAs and other activities have also resumed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Likewise, the Institutes of Higher Learning or IHLs have gradually increased the number of students allowed back on campus for practicums, laboratory sessions and other classes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They are progressively allowing selected non-timetabled activities to return to campus, including project discussions and some student activities.

sections.label: Studying more in-person activities
sections.summary: With conditions in place, ways to resume more in-person activities safely in schools and IHLs are being studied to provide a holistic educational experience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: With these conditions in place, we are now studying ways to resume more in-person activities safely in our schools and IHLs, as the Member has suggested.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: These activities, together with the resumption of a wider range of CCAs and other activities, are important because we must strive to provide our students with a holistic educational experience, while keeping risks to a manageable level.
